title: Joint-dependence weekly draws (shared game/team factor, then Gaussian copula over quantile marginals)
current_method: sd=max(0.5, mean*CV_pos), FALLBACK_CV_BY_POSITION unless box-local fit exists; no correlation
evidence: sim_calibration.py PointsModel (~lines 128-185); V3 challenger failed (docs/league-intelligence/SIM_CALIBRATION_V3_RESULTS_2026-10-27.md); DFS copula architecture in src/dfs/distributions.py + correlation.py (ADR-DFS-015); external: Haugh & Singal SSRN 3393127, arXiv 2112.07002
baseline: A0 independent Gaussian; strong-simple: one latent game factor
proposed: A1 factor/copula dependence with champion marginals; A2 adds right-skewed marginals
mechanism: Stacked rosters change team-total variance; independence mis-states it in a roster-dependent direction
data_available: Kickoff-locked weekly baselines (game_day_estimates), schedule, realised scores, exact lineup solver
data_missing: Count of archived locked weeks; multi-season locked baselines
consumers: Win Matchup %, Beat League Median %, playoff/title odds, pick projector, trade arms
risk: Underpowered on one league-season; mis-signed correlations; must keep owner disclosure
evaluation: POC-1: week-clustered bootstrap CRPS of team totals (primary), Brier matchup/median, PIT KS; Holm
acceptance: CRPS CI excludes 0 favouring A1; no secondary worse beyond margin; replicates or labelled pilot
rejection: CI includes 0; gain only via widening; >2 sign contradictions; insufficient locked data
novelty_note: Correlated sims are standard in DFS; season-long best-ball matchup/median odds with dependence: no public equivalent found (uncertain)
